input_origin: dataset/benchmark_smoke_fixture.csv; IDs renamed and fixed_block added
split_rule: fold 1 holds out block_A; fold 2 holds out block_B; each block has 6 records
chemical_scope: Blocks are arbitrary teaching labels, not substrates, scaffolds, or independent experiments.

resource_policy.live_configuration: CPU thread fields omitted; use installed model-library defaults or configure explicitly for the local machine
resource_policy.historical_resource_parameters: Preserved only in frozen evidence; not current defaults

current_configuration.historical_execution: The existing launch/status/checks describe the earlier configuration hash and historical task name. This renamed task has not been run.

record_scope: Historical completed-task evidence with a separate, statically validated current configuration. Historical task_name and execution fields do not claim this renamed task has run.

migration.historical_snapshot_distribution: Local ignored backup only; old ZIP distributions were redundant and removed after identity audit.

previous_current_configuration.change: Input paths now resolve from both example/<package> and config/example; outputs use repository result/example. Input bytes, descriptors, model parameters and evaluation settings are unchanged.
previous_current_configuration.historical_execution: The existing launch, status, checks and snapshots describe the earlier configuration hash; this output-path revision has not been rerun.

migration.protected_bytes: Inputs, split/audit records, report assets, predictions, models and completed snapshots retain their original SHA-256 values.
migration.historical_evidence_readme: Explanatory README documents were consolidated into the project README and removed from example/. Original data, source YAML, predictions and reports remain unchanged.
